issues.description: The problem statement (and the reference solution) specify simulate_msd_two_rounds should accept an optional batch_size parameter (simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots:int, p: float, batch_size:int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]). The template's function signature for simulate_msd_two_rounds omits the batch_size parameter (def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots:int, p: float) -> tuple[float, float]). This parameter mismatch will confuse students implementing two-round simulation (the docstring in the template even documents batch_size), and prevents them from following the intended batching design expected by the problem and solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template function signature match the problem statement and solution by adding the batch_size parameter with a default value. For example: def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]:. Alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to remove the batch_size parameter if batching is not intended.
